scripts.build: npm run build:client && npm run build:server
scripts.start: if [ -n "$DATABASE_URL" ]; then npm run db:migrate:pg; else npm run db:migrate; fi && node server/dist/bundle-server.mjs
scripts.build:server: esbuild server/runtime/server.ts --bundle --platform=node --format=esm --outfile=server/dist/bundle-server.mjs --external:better-sqlite3 --external:pg --external:express && esbuild server/runtime/migrate-pg.ts --bundle --platform=node --format=esm --outfile=server/dist/bundle-migrate-pg.mjs --external:pg && esbuild server/runtime/migrate.ts --bundle --platform=node --format=esm --outfile=server/dist/bundle-migrate.mjs --external:better-sqlite3
